youtube.title: The Window Shape That Cost 56 Lives ✈️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Why is no airplane window ever square? Because of a plane that came apart in the sky in 1954. The de Havilland Comet, the first jet airliner, had big, almost square windows. Their sharp corners trapped stress with every flight, and the metal slowly cracked. Today every airliner has oval windows, a shape paid for with 56 lives. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #aviation #history #engineering #thehiddenwhy
